_readme: THE SOLVER AT HAULOVER (PHASE C1, out/integration/plan_phase_c.md). The Haulover gate scene with
the shallow-water solver standing at Baker's Haulover Inlet instead of the Merrimack: its domain is
the harvested place's box (data/places/haulover.json), its anchor the box's centre, its cells the
survey's angular cell over the box in true metres there, its bed the one height stack (Haulover's
CUDEM tiles where they cover), its tide stations Haulover's own (data/tides/haulover), and no
river: the sponge stands on whichever sides of the box are open sea by the bed. Nothing in the
code names this place; only these keys do. PHASE C3: its tide focus and datum link are the station
nearest the solver's anchor (Haulover Pier), its currents Haulover's own file, and the jet stands at
the current station the domain holds (Bakers Haulover Cut), placed by CO-OPS's station list.
